h1: La Villa Boutique Hotel Aranyaprathet — a quiet little boutique with pool + sauna near Rong Kluea Market
intro: If you want a small, quiet place to stay before crossing the Khlong Luek border or shopping at Rong Kluea Market, La Villa Boutique Hotel Aranyaprathet is a boutique hotel that TripAdvisor ranks near the top in Aranyaprathet · Opened in 2013 with only around 17 rooms, it feels more private than the bigger hotels · Guests especially like the outdoor pool and Finnish sauna — rare at this price point — along with clean rooms, strong showers and friendly staff · Rooms start from approx. ฿1,200/night, making it a good fit for couples or travellers who want a small boutique at a gentle price.

body.html: La Villa Boutique Hotel Aranyaprathet sits at 11/1-11/2 Ban Khok Road, Aranyaprathet Subdistrict, Aranyaprathet, Sa Kaeo Province — in the Aranyaprathet area, near Rong Kluea Market and the Khlong Luek border crossing into Poipet on the Cambodian side · It's a small boutique hotel of around 17 rooms, open since 2013, designed as a warm-toned villa with a garden · TripAdvisor ranks it at the top among Aranyaprathet's boutique stays, based on dozens of guest reviews.

What sets it apart from other places at a similar price is the outdoor pool and Finnish sauna · Many reviews note their surprise that a small border-town hotel offers a sauna at all, and some suite rooms even add a private jacuzzi and a balcony looking over the pool or garden · Guests also consistently praise the clean rooms, strong showers and comfortable beds, plus friendly staff who help arrange tuk-tuks and share useful border-crossing tips.
"Room was clean, showers were great, staff friendly, the sauna was very good and the European breakfast was tasty — great value for money near the border. Will definitely return."

This place suits an overnight stop before crossing the border or a day shopping at Rong Kluea Market more than a long stay · It has an on-site cafe and restaurant, and the European-style breakfast often draws praise from international guests, with free parking, free Wi-Fi and a small gym · The atmosphere is quiet thanks to the low room count, which makes it a nice pick for couples or anyone wanting more privacy than a big hotel.

To be honest — the location is fairly quiet and a way from restaurants outside the hotel · Some reviews say you may need to walk around 15 minutes to find a place to eat, so without a car it's worth asking the front desk to call a tuk-tuk · Breakfast opinions are mixed: some love it, while others say the choices are limited and inconsistent · A few rooms have also drawn the odd review about mosquitoes or firm beds, so ask to see the room first if you can, or let the front desk know if something isn't right.

Overall, La Villa Boutique Hotel Aranyaprathet works well for shoppers heading to Rong Kluea Market, travellers crossing into Poipet, or couples wanting a small, quiet boutique with a pool and sauna at a good price · The overall score of around 8.4 from real reviews reflects exactly what it is — clean rooms, a proper pool and sauna, friendly staff, traded against a quiet location away from outside dining and breakfast that splits opinion · With a car, or a little extra travel time planned in, most guests stay comfortably and feel it's good value.

faqTitle: FAQ — La Villa Boutique Hotel Aranyaprathet, Sa Kaeo

faq.q: Where is La Villa Boutique Hotel Aranyaprathet · is it near Rong Kluea Market?
faq.a: It's at 11/1-11/2 Ban Khok Road, Aranyaprathet Subdistrict, Aranyaprathet, Sa Kaeo Province · about 10 minutes by car from Rong Kluea Market and the Khlong Luek border (the crossing into Poipet) · The location is fairly quiet, so without a car ask the front desk to call a tuk-tuk.

faq.q: What's the starting price · what room types are there?
faq.a: Prices start from approx. ฿1,200/night for a Superior room · There's also a Deluxe Twin around ฿1,400, a Cabana Garden Terrace around ฿1,700, and a Suite with Garden View with private jacuzzi and in-room sauna around ฿2,200 · Prices vary by season, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does it have a pool and sauna?
faq.a: Yes — both an outdoor pool and a Finnish sauna, plus a small gym · Some suite rooms even add a private jacuzzi and balcony, which many reviews note is rare for a stay at this price (the sauna may carry an extra charge at times, so ask the front desk).

faq.q: What are the rooms and breakfast like?
faq.a: Rooms are clean with strong showers and comfortable beds, each with a balcony, mini-bar and work desk · Breakfast is European-style and many international guests like it, but some reviews say the choices are limited and inconsistent, so keep expectations flexible.

faq.q: Can you walk to restaurants from the hotel?
faq.a: The location is fairly quiet and a way from outside restaurants · some reviews say it can be around a 15-minute walk to find a place to eat · Without a car, ask the front desk to call a tuk-tuk, or bring some snacks if you arrive late.

faq.q: Who is this hotel best for?
faq.a: It's best for Rong Kluea Market shoppers, travellers crossing into Poipet, or couples wanting a small, quiet boutique with a pool and sauna · It suits people who value privacy and clean rooms over being right next to restaurants.
